name: shuiyuan-unread-first-plugin
description: 水源社区（shuiyuan.sjtu.edu.cn）推荐栏未读优先 Firefox MV3 扩展

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --ignore-files test refs PLAN.md package.json package-lock.json README.md
scripts.build: web-ext build --overwrite-dest --filename=shuiyuan-unread-first.zip --ignore-files test refs PLAN.md package.json package-lock.json README.md
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --channel=unlisted --ignore-files test refs PLAN.md package.json package-lock.json README.md
